title: Segmented on‑prem metered licensing with milestone-based upgrade cadence & SQ automation
creator: Leah Armstrong
description:
Objective:
Run a structured experiment to validate a segmented on‑prem packaging model that combines a base license fee + metered capacity credits, paired with milestone-based upgrade entitlements and an automated Security Questionnaire (SQ) response flow to reduce sales friction for enterprise customers.

Hypotheses:
1) A combined model (base license + metered credits) will increase initial contract velocity vs. a pure fixed-fee on‑prem SKU by making cost elastic for variable workloads.
2) Milestone-based upgrade entitlements (e.g., yearly major upgrade, optional paid 'continuous upgrade' add-on) reduce perceived upgrade risk and lower legal negotiation time.
3) Automated SQ artifacts (pre-filled answers + downloadable audit trails from the console) will cut security‑review time by >=30% for pilot customers.

Success metrics (measured during a 6‑month pilot):
- Time to contract signature (median) reduction of >=20% vs baseline (previous 6 months of on‑prem deals).
- Pilot ARR uplift: +15% ARR per closed deal vs baseline proposal.
- Security review cycle time: median reduction >=30%.
- Churn proxy: downgrade/renewal intent at 12 months >= 90% for customers on metered model.

Proposed packaging (experiment arms):
A: Base license (annual) + metered credits (GPU-hour equivalent) consumed monthly. Support tiers: Standard (business hours), Premium (+24/7 on-call), SLA+ (guaranteed P99 latency targets for Dedicated pools). Upgrade cadence: 1 major upgrade/year included, patch window for security fixes.
B: Higher base license with unlimited minor upgrades, but fixed consumption estimate included (overage at discounted rates).
C: Base license + optional 'Managed Upgrade' subscription (quarterly minor + hotfix stream) + metered credits.

Milestone-based upgrade design:
- Each contract includes explicit upgrade milestones (M1: initial deployment; M2: first production roll; M3: 12-month major upgrade) that unlock upgrade credits and rollback guarantees.
- Customers can purchase a continuous upgrade add-on that guarantees monthly minor upgrades and emergency hotfix backporting for critical CVEs.
- Upgrade windows and responsibilities documented in SOW (operations playbook for on‑prem teams).

Security questionnaire automation:
- Build a canonical SQ bundle with: pre-filled answers, exported console audit logs (7/30/90 day), KMS/HSM attestation template, and a compliance checklist.
- Integrate exporter into Redwood Console: one-click generate ZIP for sales/legal review.
- Provide a templated cover letter/legal attestation for finance/contracts teams.

Instrumentation and telemetry to add:
- New billing metrics: metered_credit_consumed (gpu_hours), overage_events, upgrade_addon_flag.
- Sales CRM fields: packaging_arm, upgrade_addon_selected, sq_bundle_generated_at.
- RD dashboards: pilot cohort funnel, SQ turnaround times, contract cycle length.

Stakeholders & owners:
- PM owner: Evan Patel (this ticket)
- Eng: Private Deployments team (runtime + console) — implement SQ exporter + billing hooks.
- Legal: contract template + SOW wording.
- Finance: pricing model and billing integration.
- Solutions/SE: pilot enablement and playbook.

Dependencies:
- Console export APIs (ENG-5123) for audit logs and config snapshots.
- Billing ingestion pipeline work to accept metered credits (BILL-88).
- Legal sign-off on upgrade SLA language and template.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Metered model increases billing disputes. Mitigation: clear observability and invoice line-items + customer-facing usage portal.
- Risk: Customers misinterpret upgrade cadence. Mitigation: explicit milestones + SOW checklist + optional managed upgrade.
- Risk: SQ automation leakage of PII. Mitigation: redact sensitive fields and require customer consent before export.

Pilot plan:
- Select 3 anchor customers (existing on‑prem prospects with varying sizes: SMB, mid-market, enterprise) and run A/B across two customers + C as a managed option.
- 8-week pilot window per customer: week 0 (contract proposal) -> week 8 (contract signature or stop).
- Weekly syncs with SE/legal to capture negotiation blockers.

Artifacts & links:
- Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PM/pages/SEGMENTED-ONPREM-PACKAGING (draft)
- Drive: onboarding playbook (drive.google.com/drive/folders/segment-onprem-pilot)
- GH proto: github.com/redwood-inference/private-billing-protos/pulls (proto drafts for metered credits)

Next steps (short-term):
1) Align on pricing bands and credit conversions with Finance by 2026-03-20.
2) Legal draft of upgrade/SLA clauses by 2026-03-28.
3) Engineering scoping for Console SQ export + billing fields; block-level estimate due 2026-03-19.
4) Identify pilot customers and schedule kickoff (goal: pilot start 2026-04-06).
